# Meal prep Sundays

## Why
Twelve-hour shifts plus 50 to 68 km a week of running means if I don't have food in the fridge I eat the cafeteria fries at 2 am. Sunday afternoon, 1 pm to about 3:30 pm, podcast on, Dev on dishes. It's honestly my favourite part of the week now.

## Shopping
No Frills on Dundas for the bulk stuff, then the Portuguese bakery on Roncesvalles for bread. Average spend in 2025 is $112 a week for the two of us (tracked in [[Budget spreadsheet]], grocery line). The PC Optimum points paid for Christmas chocolates last year.

Standing list:
- chicken thighs, boneless skinless, 2 kg ($19.80 on the family pack)
- extra-firm tofu × 2
- jasmine rice, the 8 kg bag lasts a month
- frozen stir fry veg × 2 bags, broccoli, red peppers × 3
- eggs × 30, spinach, feta
- Greek yogurt 1.75 kg tub, rolled oats, chia, frozen berries
- sweet potatoes × 6

## The plan
### 1. Rice first
6 cups dry jasmine rice in the Zojirushi, water ratio from [[Rice cooker ratios]]. Makes enough for 8 shift lunches.

### 2. Chicken
Thighs marinated in soy, garlic, ginger, honey and gochujang, sheet pan at 220°C for 22 minutes, rest, slice. 2 kg raw gives about 1.4 kg cooked.

### 3. Tofu
Pressed 20 min, cubed, cornstarch, air fryer 200°C 15 min. Dev eats half straight off the tray, so now I make 2 blocks.

### 4. Veg
Half for the bowls, roasted. Half raw in a container for a quick weeknight version of [[Weeknight stir fry]] on Wednesday.

### 5. Egg muffins
12 in the muffin tin: eggs, spinach, feta, red pepper. 180°C for 20 min. 2 of them is my 5 am breakfast on day shifts.

### 6. Overnight oats
5 jars: 50 g oats, 150 g yogurt, 100 ml milk, chia, berries, 1 scoop whey. Protein math in [[Protein intake]].

## Containers
- 10 glass Pyrex 3-cup containers, labelled with masking tape and the date
- shift lunches only last 4 days safely, so Thursday's food gets frozen on Sunday and moved to the fridge Wednesday night
- the unit fridge on 7B is a war zone, always a name and date on the lid

## Cost per meal
For the week of 2025-09-07:
- chicken bowls: $3.40 each
- tofu bowls: $2.60 each
- egg muffins: $0.55 each
- overnight oats: $1.90 a jar
vs. cafeteria at $11 to $14 a meal. That's at least $60 a week saved on shift days alone.

## Long run week tweaks
- Friday night before the long run: plain pasta or rice, low fiber
- big sweet potato and egg breakfast after the long run Saturday
- in taper week the meals get more rice, less veg

## Fails
- 2025-02-16: tried a big batch of lentil curry, too spicy for Dev, I ate it for 7 days
- 2025-06-01: forgot to freeze Thursday's chicken, threw out $8 of food
- 2025-08-24: heatwave, did everything in the slow cooker so the oven stayed off, chicken came out sad and grey
